dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Nara are so powerful, because they like matches. But many Aranara are like Aranakula, they don't like matches.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara Varuna, and Nara {NICKNAME}, which one is stronger? A match between Golden Nara, Arabalika wants to see.
